section:
### A further comparison between arms

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 7.0 | 3.5 | 650 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.4 | 4.2 | 650 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 6.2 | 3.1 | 650 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.4 | 4.2 | 650 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
